## What's new

Threadnote 5.2.0-beta.3 adds personal Codex Cloud setup with private Git memory, local structural graphs, and scoped Context Briefs, while keeping local installations focused on the commands they need.

- Codex Cloud bootstrap installs three skills and a Start skill template, refreshes private Git memory, and prepares structural graphs without vector downloads.
- Cloud agents can combine graph and memory in a scoped Context Brief, then present a five-field Knowledge Delta for approval before durable sharing.
- Local installations create just `threadnote` and `threadnote-mcp-server` by default.
- Organization credential helpers follow the configured organization features, including legacy aliases required by existing setups.
- Doctor, repair, and updates use the same launcher requirements so unnecessary helpers stay removed.

[Full changelog since 5.2.0-beta.1](https://github.com/threadnote/threadnote/compare/v5.2.0-beta.1...v5.2.0-beta.3)
